nuora.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic young widow in her early thirties, tall and slim but healthy: a long narrow face, huge round dark eyes set wide apart, thin high arched eyebrows, a long thin nose, a small full mouth, a long neck and long straight black hair parted in the middle; in a black long-sleeved dress, a man's gold wedding ring hanging on a thin chain around her neck

parti.occhi: Huge, round dark eyes, the rims red and swollen from crying; the whites are clear: no fever, no sweat.
parti.bocca: Small, full, pale lips, a little bitten; healthy teeth; nothing unusual.

collo.inquadratura: her long neck and the base of her throat above the collar of the black dress
collo.segni: On a thin gold chain around her neck hangs a man's plain gold wedding ring, too big for her; the skin of the neck is healthy: no swelling, no lumps.

ascelle.inquadratura: her left armpit and the inside of her raised upper arm, nothing else: she raises her left arm, the long black sleeve pushed up to the shoulder, while the black dress still covers her chest and her side completely
ascelle.segni: Pale, healthy skin in the armpit, with no swelling and no marks at all.

mani.inquadratura: both hands held out in front, palms up, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Long, thin fingers; the hands are red, raw and deeply chapped, the skin cracked and peeling on the fingers and the knuckles, as from scrubbing with bleach several times a day for weeks; otherwise healthy, the fingertips normal.
